descriptions.d24i_subscribe_messages_801037a8: Walk the zero-terminated message-name table 0x803fcd58: for each name build a cached message name (0x8015f518), allocate a zero-initialized 4-byte receiver slot (0x801fe1d8), append it to the owner's pointer vector at +372 with byte-addressed growth, subscribe the owner to the message's cached id with that slot (0x80162024), and destroy the name (0x8015f558).
